gate: Do not run performance pilot until loaded lifecycle/failure and rejected-destination fallback coverage passes. Apply archived patch only after verifying base and hashes.

arms.A: Qualified production source unchanged; existing WRITE ACK helper
arms.B: Archived CPU-targeted completion candidate, default placement to admission CPU; existing WRITE ACK batching unchanged

raw_target_order: raw-first in odd rounds, target-first in even rounds in both source blocks

matched_inputs.fixture_and_plan_hashes: Must match across sources; record before first timed sample
matched_inputs.models: Unchanged make fast_test RAM null_blk models; configured NVMe rates do not imply physical fidelity

primary_family.endpoint: Within-round B/A change in useful WRITE normalized by each source block own raw WRITE, using paired log ratios
primary_family.direction_test: Exact two-sided signs; alpha=0.05/3, adjusted p=min(1,3*p)

exclusions: Exclude both source blocks of a scenario/round if either has ERROR, NOISY or UNKNOWN, missing counters/oracles, or source/input/CPU geometry mismatch
Exclude both blocks if paired raw WRITE max/min spread exceeds 10%
No replacement observations, extra repeats or adaptive stopping for significance; preserve every measurement
secondary: Pointwise descriptive 95% paired log intervals for useful READ, READ/WRITE p95/p99, independent lower bytes/requests, fast WRITE QD1/4/8, GC, CPU and memory. No new direction claims; do not add overlapping CPU/wall timers. Native task CPU excludes kernel workers.
screen_decision: Advance only if NVMe5 point reaches +3%, its family interval is above zero and its family-adjusted sign p is below 0.05, with at least nine valid pairs. Any primary/guard material harm, unresolved correctness/resource issue or unexpected lower-IO geometry requires review before retention. Otherwise decline this variant without replacement sampling. Exact-source make test remains mandatory before retention.
next_correctness_gates: Positive remote READ/WRITE delivery on concurrent and synchronous paths (initial four owned pairs pass)
Loaded suspend/resume and ordinary teardown with exact upper completion accounting and callback count zero
Lower WRITE fault after actual remote deliveries, terminal failure preserved at callback and DM boundaries
Real kernel rejected-destination API fallback without offlining a host CPU; native already covers ENXIO and EBUSY
Review remote callback hardirq context and bounded pool reuse, callback-final-unlock lifetime join, constructor-failure teardown
guard_material_harm_screen: Flag a guard with point <= -3% useful throughput and pointwise 95% upper bound below zero; review before retention. This is descriptive screening, not a new family-adjusted harm claim.
